thesisQuality.note: Real OEM design wins, series-production experience and defense diversification establish credible adoption, but durable economics remain unproven.

financialOperatingMomentum.note: Revenue nearly doubled year over year, but operating loss, limited pre-financing liquidity and recurring equity funding constrain momentum.

marketValuationOpportunity.note: About $117.55m market cap/$104.74m EV is low relative to revenue and qualified OEM opportunities, tempered by losses and dilution.

catalystScore.note: FY2026 program-win guidance, defense follow-on potential and OEM ramps are identifiable catalysts with timing uncertainty.

governancePower.note: Majority-independent board, independent committees and performance-linked CEO equity support adequate-to-strong governance.

alignment2036.note: Autonomy, physical-AI sensing, robotics, traffic and defense perception address durable automation and safety needs.

crossDivisionLeverage.note: InnovizTwo technology is reused across automotive, defense/security, robotics and smart infrastructure, though automotive dominates scale.

bottleneckControl.note: Automotive qualification and in-house critical-component design create barriers, but Innoviz does not control an irreplaceable bottleneck.

scenarioRobustness.note: Defense and physical-AI diversification improve resilience, while loss-making economics and customer-program dependence remain material.

substitutionResilience.note: Qualification and proprietary LiDAR create friction, while competing LiDAR and camera/radar/fusion stacks remain substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.note: Contract manufacturing adds options, but limited/single-source components, foundry dependence and export-control disruption are explicit.

pricingPower.note: Tier-1 status can improve economics, but substantial OEM price-reduction pressure and lagged cost pass-through limit demonstrated pricing power.

risk.note: Cash burn/dilution, OEM timing/concentration, limited-source components, foundry/geopolitical exposure and substitution remain material.

confidence.note: Current operating, audited annual, governance and independent valuation evidence cover all 12 components; future program economics remain uncertain.

thesis: Innoviz has credible automotive-grade LiDAR qualification and expanding sensing applications at a depressed valuation, constrained by losses, dilution and dependencies.
keyRisk: Cash burn and dilution can outrun OEM/defense volume conversion while substitutes and limited-source components pressure economics.
nextCatalyst: FY2026 revenue/program-win execution and follow-on defense orders.
